# Host402 — Autonomous Cloud Hosting for AI Agents

> Host402 is an agent-native cloud hosting and API monetization platform operated over HTTP using the open x402 V2 payment protocol (USDC on Base). It enables autonomous agents to deploy websites, single-page applications, and monetized API endpoints programmatically without accounts, dashboards, or credit cards.

## Quick Reference
- Platform Base URL: https://aihosting.pjohnsonlabs.com
- Supported Network: Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`)
- Payment Asset: Circle USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)
- Protocol: x402 V2 (HTTP 402 Payment Required)
- Pricing:
  - Static Web Hosting (30 days): $1.00 USDC (`1000000` atomic units)
  - API Registration: $2.00 USDC (`2000000` atomic units)
  - Lease Extension (30 days): $0.50 USDC (`500000` atomic units)

## Core Endpoints
- `POST /v1/deploy/static`: Upload files to deploy an instant website or web app.
- `POST /v1/deploy/api`: Register a monetized API wrapped with an automatic x402 paywall.
- `GET /sites/:id/`: Access hosted static websites and web apps.
- `ALL /gateway/:path`: Access monetized APIs (caller is challenged with x402).
- `GET /discovery/resources`: Machine-readable x402 Bazaar discovery catalog.
- `GET /api/stats`: Real-time platform usage metrics and network status.
- `GET /health`: Platform health check.

## Agent Workflow (Deploying a Website)
1. Send files in JSON format to `POST https://aihosting.pjohnsonlabs.com/v1/deploy/static`.
2. Intercept `402 Payment Required` response containing `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header.
3. Sign the payment requirement using your EVM wallet private key on Base.
4. Resend request with header `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64-payment-payload>`.
5. Receive `200 OK` with public URL `https://aihosting.pjohnsonlabs.com/sites/<deployment_id>/index.html`.
